title: Bead Beating in Custom Buffer Followed by XP Bead Cleanup
author: Jason D Limberis
materials: rpm, °C, Centrifuge at max speed for 00:10:00

steps.title: Prepare Custom Triton Buffer
steps.instruction: For 100 mL, mix 2 mL 5 M NaCl, 1 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 8.3, 0.2 mL 0.5 M EDTA pH 9.0, 1 mL Triton X‑100, and add water to a final volume of 95.8 mL; also prepare a second 100 mL solution containing 1 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 8, 1 mL 0.5 M EDTA, and 20 µL of the indicated component.

steps.title: Decontaminate MGIT culture (if required)
steps.instruction: Heat the MGIT culture in its original tube at 80 °C for 1 hour following your facility’s standard operating procedures.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in custom buffer
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL of the Custom Triton Buffer to the pellet and vortex to resuspend.

steps.title: Transfer to bead‑beating tube
steps.instruction: Move the inactivated bacterial suspension to a new StarSted screw‑cap tube that already contains ~250 µL of Mini‑BeadBeater Zirconia‑Silicate beads (‑0.1 mm).

steps.title: Optional second decontamination
steps.instruction: If required for BSL‑3 removal, decontaminate the sample again according to your facility’s SOPs.

steps.title: Vortex sample
steps.instruction: Vortex the tube at maximum speed for 15 minutes (rpm and temperature as specified by the instrument).

steps.title: Remove supernatant and resuspend pellet
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, then resuspend the remaining pellet in 350 µL of Custom Triton Buffer.

steps.title: Incubate at room temperature
steps.instruction: Incubate the suspension at room temperature for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Add DTT and vortex
steps.instruction: Add four volumes of 100 mM dithiothreitol to the sputum sample and vortex for more than 30 seconds.

steps.title: Alternative MycoPrep method (optional)
steps.instruction: If the above cannot be performed, process the sample with BBL MycoPrep™ according to the manufacturer’s instructions, modifying the protocol by resuspending the sediment in 350 µL of Custom Triton Buffer (step 8).

steps.title: Prepare StarSted bead tubes
steps.instruction: Cut the bottom off a StarSted tube just below the inflection point; cut the tip off a P1000 tip, make a wedge near the end, and wedge the StarSted tube into it. Fill a sterile container (e.g., Petri dish) with ‑0.1 mm Zirconia‑Silicate beads and distribute the beads into 1.5 mL StarSted tubes using the prepared scoop.

steps.title: Ethanol wash of beads
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL freshly prepared 70 % (v/v) ethanol to each bead‑containing tube without disturbing the beads; repeat this wash twice, using a p20 pipette to remove all remaining ethanol after each wash.

steps.title: Bead‑beat lysate
steps.instruction: Place the tube in the bead‑beater and run at 6.5 m/s for 45 seconds, then rest for 1 minute; repeat this cycle until a total of three bead‑beating cycles have been completed.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at ≥10 000 rcf, room temperature, for 2 minutes; carefully transfer the supernatant to a new labeled tube, avoiding beads and cell debris.

steps.title: Add AMPure XP beads
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL (1.2× the volume of the supernatant) AMPure XP beads to the supernatant and mix by pipetting up and down 10 times.

steps.title: Incubate bead‑DNA mixture
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Magnetic separation – first clear
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnetic rack and wait approximately 1 minute for the solution to become clear.

steps.title: Ethanol wash of AMPure beads
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL 70 % ethanol without disturbing the beads; repeat this wash twice, using a p20 pipette to remove all remaining ethanol after each wash.

steps.title: Dry beads briefly
steps.instruction: Allow the beads to air‑dry for about 1 minute; remove any residual ethanol with a p10 pipette.

steps.title: Resuspend beads in low‑EDTA buffer
steps.instruction: Immediately after the bead pellet becomes opaque, remove the tube from the magnetic rack and resuspend the beads in 20 µL Low‑EDTA Tris Buffer, ensuring all beads are fully in solution.

steps.title: Incubate resuspended beads
steps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Final magnetic separation and elution
steps.instruction: Place the tube on the magnetic rack, wait ~30 seconds for the solution to clear, then transfer the eluate (DNA) to a new labeled tube.
